title: Split Rule
description: Defines when/how an order is decomposed into sub-orders - independent of which workflow the result triggers (see workflow-trigger.schema.json) and of what happens once sub-orders complete (see completion-rule.schema.json).

condition.description: References an id in elements/split_reasons.yaml, e.g. 'storage_technology_split', 'multi_location_availability'.

split_by.description: The dimension sub-orders are split along.

target_override.description: Overrides the sub-order's MOVEMENT TARGET ('target') only - never its 'order_target', which is always inherited unchanged from the parent regardless of this override. Use when the executing system for this sub-order can't reach the parent's target directly - e.g. an AutoStore sub-order's target is the cell's own EXIT work_center, not the parent's outbound door. Omit if the sub-order's executing system can reach the parent's target directly, so 'target' inherits unchanged too.
